about: Spoken lines of the safe zone characters. type: greeting (said every few seconds from where the character stands, so the player can find them), callback (said now and then while the player has walked away before the gift), gift (said when handing over the gift), story-hint (a story line that counts as hearing a storyline hint, which the world's mercy needs), story (a story line that is not a hint). phonemes is the whole line in Kokoro phonemes (Misaki notation, British for gb characters), ready for the model; text is what is shown on a Braille display. ids are stable: new lines are only ever added at the end of a character's list, so the saved list of heard ids stays valid.

lines.text: I once saw the whole world go dark for a moment, from orbit. Every light, every sound. Then it lit up again, brand new. It was the most beautiful thing I've ever seen.
